pie.iecor_comment: Kroonen writes that the Germanic words may either be related to forms such as Greek κρατύς and Sanskrit krátu- (with Germanic showing Schwebeablaut) or related to Lithuanian kir̃sti 'to turn sour'. According to ALEW, this verb is derived from the PIE root *(s)kert- 'to cut, to cut in two'.In the EWA, the two explanations Kroonen mentions are actually unified, the root reconstruction being "uridg. *(s)kret- (oder [s]kert- [?])".The LIV² only has a root *(s)kert-.
